question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a gold ball, Bob has a teal ball, Claire has a yellow ball, Dave has a orange ball, and Eve has a grey ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Eve and Dave swap balls. Then, Dave and Claire swap balls. Then, Alice and Dave swap balls. Then, Dave and Alice swap balls. Finally, Dave and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Eve has the
Options:
(A) gold ball
(B) teal ball
(C) yellow ball
(D) orange ball
(E) grey ball
solution:
Holder order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve.
Initial: gold | teal | yellow | orange | grey
1. Eve ↔ Dave: gold | teal | yellow | grey | orange
2. Dave ↔ Claire: gold | teal | grey | yellow | orange
3. Alice ↔ Dave: yellow | teal | grey | gold | orange
4. Dave ↔ Alice: gold | teal | grey | yellow | orange
5. Dave ↔ Claire: gold | teal | yellow | grey | orange
Eve has the orange ball, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
